description: Bornes IRVE Bulle de Linge is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bulle de Linge. Bubble de Linge offers a complete outsourcing service for residents’ laundry maintenance. In its 10 production units, Bulle de Linge maintains the daily linen of more than 55,000 residents in 750 establishments. Coverage: Bulle de Linge. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE Linen Bull terminals" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bulle de Linge. Its keywords include borne-de-recharge-electrique, irve, borne-de-recharge, borne-electrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
